description: A slab of end-grain maple on a steel frame, scrubbed pale and dished in the middle where forty years of the same cuts have worn it away. A spring scale hangs over it, its dial stopped near a number that's nobody's weight. Vesna Kroh works behind it, and doesn't put the cleaver down to talk to you.
